info.title: Documentation for eCAPI v2
info.description: eCAPI v2 is the enhanced consumer API for retrieving ePILs, searching for medicinal products, and company information.

get.summary: Return eCAPI version information from nelmio_api_doc.yaml

schema.description: Object keyed by major version group (e.g. "v1", "v2"). Each key maps to an array of version entries ordered newest-first within that group.

v1.description: All registered v1 minor/patch releases, ordered newest first.

items.description: Version lifecycle metadata for a single eCAPI release.

version.description: Semantic version number of this release (semver).

reference_url.description: URL to the API reference documentation for this version.

release_notes_url.description: URL to the release notes for this version.

is_deprecated.description: True when this version is officially deprecated and clients should migrate away.

sunrise_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this version became available. Null means available from the beginning.

sundown_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the sunset period began. The version still works but support is winding down. Null means no sunset is scheduled.

retirement_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this version was permanently retired. Requests to retired endpoints may be rejected. Null means no retirement is scheduled.

get.description: Find medicinal products by PZN, GTIN, medicinal product name, or ORG-ID

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search by PZN, GTIN, or medicinal product name (partial search). One of `q` or `org-id` is required.

parameters.name: org-id
parameters.description: Search by company ORG-ID (partial search) with Schema ORG-1000XXXXX. One of `q` or `org-id` is required.

org-id.description: Search by company ORG-ID (partial search) with Schema ORG-1000XXXXX.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (default is 5, minimum is 5, maximum is 50).

limit.description: Number of results per page (default is 5, minimum is 5, maximum is 50).

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag of a previously cached representation. If it still matches, the server responds 304 Not Modified with an empty body.

304.description: Not Modified — the client-cached representation is still valid; the response body is empty.

200.description: Response body contains medicinal product search results in FHIR XML or JSON format.

400.description: Only one parameter ('q' or 'org-id') is allowed, not both.

both-parameters-given.summary: Only one parameter ('q' or 'org-id') is allowed, not both.

invalid-characters.summary: The query contains characters that are not allowed.

coding.code: The query may only contain letters, umlauts, numbers, whitespace, and the following markers/special characters: ®, (R), ™, TM, ©, (C), ℠, SM, -, /, °, `,`, `.`, µ(0xC2B5), μ(0xCEBC), @, &, <sup></sup><sub></sub>
